extension.description: Automatically selects preferred-language Signs/Songs subtitle tracks on episode transitions. Extends Kodi's forced_only mode to also pick up tracks named "signs" or "songs" that aren't flagged as forced in the container.
extension.news: v0.4.0 - Only auto-select tracks in the configured preferred subtitle languages (English by default). This prevents a similarly named Forced or Signs/Songs track in another language from overriding the intended subtitle, and disables an automatically selected non-preferred forced track. v0.3.0 - Fix auto-select skipped on episode transitions. Kodi reports a stale `currentsubtitle.index` for tens of ms after onAVStarted (carry-over from the previous file), which fooled the 'don't override user choice' guard. The guard now also requires `subtitleenabled=true`, which is the reliable signal that Kodi has resolved the new file's subtitle state. When forced_only finds no flagged forced track on the new file, Kodi disables subtitles entirely — addon now correctly fires in that case. v0.2.0 - Add 'forced' to default keywords so tracks named 'Forced' (e.g. anime release-group variants like 'Forced (freeka)', 'Forced (Doki)') are auto-selected even when the MKV container does not set the forced flag bit. Kodi's forced_only locale mode only matches the flag bit, not the track name, so authored 'Forced' tracks without the bit were being skipped. v0.1.0 - Initial release. Auto-selects Signs/Songs subtitle tracks on playback start.
